scripts.dev:firebase: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev:firebase -w @gu-pms/api" "node scripts/with-env.mjs apps/web/.env.firebase -- npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @gu-pms/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.create-admin:firebase: node scripts/with-env.mjs apps/api/.env.firebase -- npm run cli -w @gu-pms/api -- create-admin
scripts.remove-demo:firebase: node scripts/with-env.mjs apps/api/.env.firebase -- npm run cli -w @gu-pms/api -- remove-demo
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @gu-pms/api && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build -w @gu-pms/api
scripts.fix-companies:firebase: node scripts/with-env.mjs apps/api/.env.firebase -- npm run cli -w @gu-pms/api -- fix-company-owners
scripts.build:web: node scripts/with-env.mjs apps/web/.env.production -- npm run build --prefix apps/web
